verdict.summary: Weekly scoped review (token-optimized): 1 of 5 prior criticals FIXED (C1 placeholder zeros, via board task W2), 4 carried as still-true with refreshed notes (C2-C5), all 4 high issues carried unchanged (no evidence of movement). 1 NEW critical opened this run: sitewide SERP position volatility (GSC: 6 critical + 39 warning position/CTR drops in the last 7 days, organic clicks -28.5% over 28 days despite impressions +3.3%) — timing matches broad, unnamed Google ranking volatility reported industry-wide from 2026-09-15, so this may not be site-caused, but the site's remaining unresolved trust/schema/entity issues (C3-C5, H1-H4) leave it more exposed to any quality reassessment. Deep multi-wave /seo-360 crawl was skipped this run; only GSC/GA4 data pulls and targeted live-site spot checks were used.

criticalIssues.title: Sitewide SERP ranking volatility — multiple high-value queries dropped 40-72 positions in 7 days
criticalIssues.detail: GSC check_alerts (2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20): 6 critical position drops (e.g. "top generative ai companies" on /us/blog/top-generative-ai-development-companies-usa/ fell from position 2 to 73; a healthcare case study fell from 4.5 to 70) plus 39 warning-level drops across global and /us/ pages. Organic clicks -28.5% over 28 days despite impressions +3.3%. GSC URL Inspection on the worst-hit URL shows it remains indexed/crawlable/canonical-matched — no technical defect found there. Independent SEO press reports broad, unnamed Google ranking volatility from 2026-09-15, matching the timing; likely industry-wide rather than a site-caused regression, but worth monitoring given the site's other unresolved trust issues.
